name: Chengdu Road & Bridge Engineering CO.,LTD
summary: Chengdu Road & Bridge Engineering CO.,LTD functions as an engineering and construction enterprise, conducting its business both within China and on the global stage. The company primarily engages in developing significant infrastructure, encompassing highways, bridges, tunnels, and urban municipal projects. Furthermore, it delivers specialized engineering services for these domains, including mechanical and electrical systems. Its capabilities also extend to laying pavements, installing various transportation amenities and commercial floating structures, and offering complete construction and project management solutions. The firm was established in 1988, with its main headquarters located in Chengdu, China.
